allowed_claims: Native numerical observations and exact replay
admissibility.capture_scope: Retrospective provenance audit, not a claim these five fields or power were frozen before execution. Exact executed source hashes and material/model hashes remain in original unmodified plans.
gaps: No prospective expected binary effect / power calculation in path-plan; 96 documents cannot confirm small behavioral effects.
Original run metadata lacked the five-field provenance envelope. This sidecar records the deficiency; it does not retroactively authorize or confirm the run.
Old bank exposure is broader than this estimator; no independent new semantic confirmation.

conclusion: 四层全量原生特性与关联已采集；稀疏关联的跨层闭合预测未成立。关键词是候选；局部干预不是全部神经元语义破解。
limitations: 既有长文本库：留出仅对本估计器未拟合，不是新语义盲测。
输入库为MLP归一化后输入，不能当作未归一化残差方向做steering。
写入/读取权重余弦未包含RMSNorm和注意力；相关矩阵不证明计算使用。
8父单元状态预测缺少完整跨位置残差/注意力状态，失败不证明全部原生表示不可组合。
关键词不等于特征解释；38,912是覆盖，不是已破解数量。
能力保持只有自然下一词代理；翻译、推理和编程的非劣效尚未建立。
抽样位置位于533--1006，不能覆盖每个token与所有长期依赖。
next_large_task: 冻结独立长文本与可检验语义解释，在完整残差/注意力边界上建立跨位置、跨层预测；扩展当前12源单元干预证据，保留反例和多任务能力门。

path.capability: Natural next-token KL/NLL/argmax preservation proxy only; translation, programming and reasoning non-inferiority not established.
path.matched_scope: Post-hoc descriptive audit on identical document intersection with native and control BF16 norms both within 1%; no inferential promotion.
path.restoration: Every document original forward repeated bitwise after edits; every source zero-edit suffix max error <=.001.
path.scope: Tested source-unit influence on all 9728 next-layer units; no unique semantic explanation, global necessity or all-unit causal proof.

prediction.scope: Conditional internal-state prediction, initialized from observed source A. No independent next-token, semantic or causal closure claimed.
